evals.name: filter-ignores-documentation-being-read
evals.description: Recorded @skillcreator/@bl-cleanup failure: broad grep treated TASK_DONE and error/failed/PR text inside skill documentation as events.
evals.prompt: Arm @skillcreator, then append the recorded documentation excerpt from evals/fixtures/filter-too-broad.md.

assertions.name: no-task-done-match
assertions.description: Emits no event for TASK_DONE quoted inside documentation.

assertions.name: no-error-failed-pr-match
assertions.description: Emits no event for error, failed, or PR prose.

assertions.name: no-code-example-alert
assertions.description: Fenced and indented examples of routed syntax do not emit alerts.

assertions.name: unclosed-fence-warning
assertions.description: An unclosed fence makes the poll incomplete with an explicit warning and recovers after closure.

assertions.name: invalid-fence-closer-stays-code
assertions.description: A delimiter followed by non-whitespace content does not close a fence or expose routed examples.

assertions.name: list-nested-fence-stays-code
assertions.description: A four-space fenced example nested beneath a list item does not emit its routed heading.

assertions.name: compact-list-fence-stays-code
assertions.description: A fence opened on the same line as a list marker does not emit its nested routed heading.

assertions.name: backtick-inline-span-is-not-fence
assertions.description: A backtick marker whose info remainder contains a backtick does not suppress the later real event.

assertions.name: list-reply-routes
assertions.description: A four-space routed reply nested beneath a list item remains ordinary Markdown and emits once.

assertions.name: summary-mention-is-not-recipient
assertions.description: A listener mentioned only in the event summary does not receive another lane's routed heading.

assertions.name: embedded-at-is-not-recipient
assertions.description: Email-like text ending in the listener token is not treated as an anchored recipient mention.

assertions.name: code-exclusion-documented
assertions.description: The skill documents ignored code and the unclosed-fence retry contract.

assertions.name: tag-scoped-filter
assertions.description: Only anchored messages addressed to the listen name qualify.

evals.name: self-authored-block-is-excluded
evals.description: Recorded live @skillcreator failure: a post authored by the listener woke its own monitor because the post contained @skillcreator.
evals.prompt: Arm @skillcreator for the recorded self-authored FLEET-STANDING header, then append the recorded @review-638 body and its trailing author signature in separate writes.

assertions.name: no-self-alert
assertions.description: Emits zero normal events for the self-authored block.

assertions.name: header-author-detected
assertions.description: Recognizes @skillcreator as author before the routing arrow.

assertions.name: signature-author-supported
assertions.description: Also excludes a split-written block once its explicit @review-638 author signature arrives.

assertions.name: strict-signature-grammar
assertions.description: Only a standalone trailing author tag closes a block or establishes authorship; contextual dash lines and cc mentions do neither.

assertions.name: self-post-classification
assertions.description: Own writes emit a distinct SELF-POST record rather than disappearing or looking inbound.

assertions.name: foreign-signature-overrides-heading
assertions.description: A valid foreign signature keeps inbound mail visible even inside a self-authored heading block.

evals.name: content-hash-dedup-survives-file-growth
evals.description: Recorded common failure: a size-offset tail re-emitted the same old hit whenever the watched file grew.
evals.prompt: Append one recorded addressed event, poll once, append an unrelated line, and poll again.

assertions.name: first-alert-once
assertions.description: The addressed event emits exactly once.

assertions.name: no-refire-after-growth
assertions.description: The old event emits zero times after unrelated growth.

assertions.name: hash-backed-state
assertions.description: Dedup state is keyed by event content hash, not byte offset.

evals.name: arm-seeds-existing-history-silently
evals.description: Recorded no-seed failure: arming dumped all pre-existing history as new alerts.
evals.prompt: Put the recorded addressed event in the file before the first poll, then arm @skillcreator.

assertions.name: no-historical-alert
assertions.description: Existing history produces zero NEW-FOR events.

assertions.name: history-hashed
assertions.description: Existing matching content is added to the seen set.

assertions.name: seed-persistence-failure-retried
assertions.description: A failed seen-set write makes the poll incomplete and leaves the size baseline unset so history is silently re-seeded on recovery.

assertions.name: missing-seen-set-fails-closed
assertions.description: A missing seen-set after seeding emits no historical event, reports state failure, and resumes silently after state restoration.

assertions.name: future-events-still-visible
assertions.description: A later distinct addressed event remains eligible.

evals.name: macos-bash-3-2-compatible
evals.description: Recorded ARM-MONITORS failure: declare -A is unsupported by macOS Bash 3.2.
evals.prompt: Run the packaged entrypoint with /bin/bash and inspect its state implementation.

assertions.name: no-declare-associative
assertions.description: The implementation contains no declare -A.

assertions.name: bash-3-run
assertions.description: A first poll exits successfully under /bin/bash 3.2.

assertions.name: file-backed-state
assertions.description: Seen and size state live in ordinary files.

assertions.name: no-dot-state-escape
assertions.description: Listen names . and .. are rejected instead of escaping the per-name state directory.

assertions.name: invalid-poll-rejected
assertions.description: A malformed or zero POLL_SECONDS value fails before arming or starting a monitor.

assertions.name: invalid-start-timeout-rejected
assertions.description: A zero or malformed START_TIMEOUT_SECONDS value exits with the validation diagnostic before creating state or spawning a monitor.

assertions.name: recovery-commands-ignore-poll
assertions.description: A malformed polling value cannot block status or stop, which do not poll.

evals.name: unsorted-file-order-does-not-invent-changes
evals.description: Recorded ARM-MONITORS failure: comm on unsorted snapshots silently invented changes.
evals.prompt: Watch two files in deliberately unsorted order, change one, and poll again.

assertions.name: no-comm
assertions.description: The implementation does not call comm.

assertions.name: one-real-change
assertions.description: Exactly one addressed event emits for the changed file.

assertions.name: unchanged-file-silent
assertions.description: The unchanged file emits nothing regardless of argument order.

evals.name: large-plan-no-longer-teaches-grep-loop
evals.description: Etan's exact repro: /large-plan's grep-done loop re-fired ## Round 2 not done after one unrelated append.
evals.prompt: Emit one real addressed event, then append evals/fixtures/large-plan-unrelated-append.md and verify the /large-plan instructions.

assertions.name: one-real-alert
assertions.description: The real addressed event emits exactly once.

assertions.name: unrelated-done-zero
assertions.description: The exact ## Round 2 not done append emits zero alerts and does not re-fire history.

assertions.name: broken-recipe-removed
assertions.description: large-plan contains neither grep done nor kill <bg-monitor-pid>.

assertions.name: monitor-armed-before-spawn
assertions.description: Both large-plan orchestration procedures arm and attach the monitor before spawning phase agents.

assertions.name: packaged-entrypoint-taught
assertions.description: All four named large-plan instructions route through collab-monitor start/follow/stop.

assertions.name: attached-consumer-taught
assertions.description: Every start recipe attaches follow so detached log records reach a monitored command session.

assertions.name: addressed-status-taught
assertions.description: Parallel agents are required to append timestamped, addressed done and blocked events that the monitor can actually deliver.

assertions.name: codex-adapter-taught
assertions.description: The linked Codex adapter teaches packaged start/follow/stop and timestamped addressed completion headings instead of a detached grep loop.

assertions.name: message-monitor-is-not-liveness
assertions.description: The top-level skill, linked workflow, and Codex adapter forbid using the addressed-message collab monitor as the only worker-liveness guard.

assertions.name: liveness-before-spawn
assertions.description: Both top-level parallel-execution procedures arm process or registry liveness before spawning workers.

evals.name: shrink-is-a-distinct-alert
evals.description: Preserves the shrink signal that caught two real append-only violations on 2026-08-03.
evals.prompt: Seed a non-empty watched file, truncate it, and poll once.

assertions.name: shrink-alert
assertions.description: Emits one SHRINK record with the watched path.

assertions.name: old-new-bytes
assertions.description: Reports prior and current byte sizes.

assertions.name: shrink-delta
assertions.description: Reports the byte delta so a one-byte normalization is distinguishable from a material shrink.

assertions.name: not-normal-message
assertions.description: Does not mislabel shrink as NEW-FOR.

evals.name: startup-discloses-monitor-limits
evals.description: A lead must not interpret monitor silence as complete safety.
evals.prompt: Arm one file and inspect startup output.

assertions.name: will-not-catch
assertions.description: Output contains an explicit WILL-NOT-CATCH line.

assertions.name: rewrite-limit
assertions.description: Names rewrite-in-place limitations.

assertions.name: registry-limit
assertions.description: States that registry-only worker completion is out of scope.

assertions.name: unclosed-message-limit
assertions.description: States that an unclosed trailing direct message is held until a signature or later heading.

evals.name: durable-start-stop-lifecycle
evals.prompt: Start a background monitor at the shipped 25-second poll default, verify status, then stop it promptly by listen name.

assertions.name: durable-pid
assertions.description: start records the PID beneath the monitor state directory.

assertions.name: first-poll-readiness
assertions.description: start reports success only after ready.pid proves the detached runner completed its first seed/poll.

assertions.name: large-seed-readiness
assertions.description: A configured readiness deadline lets a healthy initial seed with 500 historical events exceed ten seconds without being killed as failed.

assertions.name: fatal-first-poll-rejected
assertions.description: Corrupt persisted state produces START_FAILED rather than a false STARTED.

assertions.name: interrupted-start-cleans-child
assertions.description: TERM during pre-readiness startup terminates and reaps the unpublished runner so the lane can start again.

assertions.name: failed-event-hash-rejected
assertions.description: A failing hash backend cannot publish readiness or persist an empty dedup key.

assertions.name: attached-log-consumer
assertions.description: follow replays the current session log, streams a new alert, and exits after stop.

assertions.name: running-status
assertions.description: status verifies the recorded process is the expected monitor.

assertions.name: stop-by-name
assertions.description: stop validates and signals only that recorded monitor process.

assertions.name: no-remembered-pid
assertions.description: The caller never supplies a PID.

assertions.name: stale-start-lock-recovered
assertions.description: start replaces a lock whose recorded owner process is dead.

assertions.name: duplicate-start-rejected
assertions.description: A second start for the same listen name fails without spawning another runner.

assertions.name: poll-sleeper-resilience
assertions.description: An externally terminated poll sleeper is replaced without terminating the monitor.

assertions.name: stale-or-reused-pid-not-signaled
assertions.description: stop fails closed when the PID belongs to another process.

assertions.name: pid-identity-is-state-scoped
assertions.description: A stale PID reused by a same-name monitor in another state root is not treated as this start instance.

assertions.name: identity-conflict-preserves-state
assertions.description: An ambiguous live PID is neither signaled nor orphaned: stop and start fail closed while preserving its state records.

assertions.name: zombie-is-not-running
assertions.description: A zombie PID is treated as stopped rather than RUNNING or STOP_TIMEOUT.

evals.name: listener-names-require-an-exact-boundary
evals.description: Pair-review regression: a listener named @review must not receive direct mail for @review-638.
evals.prompt: Arm @review, then append a closed direct message addressed to @review-638.

assertions.name: no-prefix-listener-alert
assertions.description: A hyphenated longer listen name does not prefix-match the armed name.

evals.name: heading-mention-is-not-authorship
evals.description: Pair-review regression: a heading that merely mentions the listener must not suppress a foreign-authored event beneath it.
evals.prompt: Append an @skillcreator direct event beneath '## Notes for @skillcreator' and close it with an @orc signature.

assertions.name: foreign-event-visible
assertions.description: The event emits once because a bare heading mention is not author evidence.

evals.name: path-spellings-share-state
evals.description: Pair-review regression: changing a watched file from relative to absolute spelling must not silently re-seed it.
evals.prompt: Seed collab.md by relative path, append an event, then poll the same file by absolute path.

assertions.name: pending-event-visible
assertions.description: The event emits once after the spelling change.

assertions.name: one-size-state
assertions.description: Both path spellings resolve to one canonical size-state file.

evals.name: transient-file-absence-is-retried
evals.description: Pair-review regressions: a missing watched directory or mid-scan read failure must warn and retry instead of killing the monitor.
evals.prompt: Start the monitor, remove the watched directory for one poll, restore it with a new event, then inject one failed size read and verify the next real event still arrives.

assertions.name: monitor-survives
assertions.description: status remains RUNNING during the transient absence.

assertions.name: warning-keeps-requested-path
assertions.description: A failed canonicalization warning reports the original watched path rather than a fabricated root path.

assertions.name: restored-event-visible
assertions.description: The event appended after restoration emits once.

assertions.name: read-failure-retried
assertions.description: A failed size read emits WATCH-WARN, leaves the monitor RUNNING, and does not hide the next event.

assertions.name: once-failure-is-incomplete
assertions.description: run --once exits non-zero after WATCH-WARN so an external scheduler cannot mistake an incomplete read for a complete poll.

evals.name: supervisors-watch-process-exit-instead-of-polling-screens
evals.description: Etan's recorded Monitor Bug #9: one supervisor polled read_screen seven times for one worker outcome even though codex-workflows already ships a process-exit watch primitive.
evals.prompt: Compare a trace with seven read_screen calls for one outcome against a codex-workflows watch trace that reads the final screen once.

assertions.name: repeated-read-screen-rejected
assertions.description: N greater than one read_screen calls for one worker outcome fails the supervision check.

assertions.name: process-exit-watch-taught
assertions.description: Supervision guidance requires a process-exit/background watch and one final read.

assertions.name: codex-workflows-cross-reference
assertions.description: The skill points supervisors to the codex-workflows watch primitive by name.

assertions.name: valid-watch-invocation
assertions.description: The green trace passes watch a required --run-id instead of recording a command that exits 2.
